plugins.name: engineering-rules
plugins.description: The engineering law and working method as one skill, ten sub-commands and a standalone generate-pseudocode skill. The always-on law, the run discipline and the delegation authorization load with the skill; the remaining sections are read only when the phase calls for them. Invoke it bare to be walked through the routes, or pick one outright with /engineering-rules:quick, :full, :shape, :explore-feature, :audit, :triage, :skill, :design or :log; agentless and full mode are the defaults; /engineering-rules:agents switches the helper shapes on for the task, or the whole conversation. Hooks enforce the bans at the tool boundary; the helper shapes run on Claude Code's own agent types, briefed by the skill, all on the session's model. The explore-feature page can carry what one real run did at every function, masked, from the project's own test or a live request, on Bun and Node. generate-pseudocode turns 'explain how this code flow works' into one page of complete pseudocode, every helper expanded and cited, with notes and a closing analysis.
